summary: Bounds-checked single-field write into an element array: reads the element count from this[11] (offset 0x2C) and, when the caller index a2 is within bounds, shifts it left by 7 to form a byte stride and writes a3 to element+12 using the array base pointer this[13] (offset 0x34). Returns the index when out of bounds, or the shifted index when written. Called by particle and wheel render update paths.

operations.description: Initialize the result to the caller index a2.
Guard on a2 < this[11] (element count limit at byte offset 0x2C); out-of-range indexes skip the write.
Compute the element byte offset as a2 << 7 (a shift of 7), the stride encoded in the raw source.
Write a3 into the dword at (a2 << 7) + this[13] + 12, where this[13] (byte offset 0x34) is the element array base pointer and 12 is the field displacement inside the element.
Return a2 when the index was out of bounds, or the shifted index a2 << 7 when the write occurred.
